fields.content: Hold on! This is my very first Scenery I just made! Probably one of the first Sceneries on this page at all! Hope you like it! It is very simple, I know, but yeah...
Simple transparent effect. Straightforward. Nothing special. Just Light going through some material.
Simple reflection effect. Straightforward. Nothing special. Just Light reflecting at some material. Its a perfect mirror reflection. For diffuse reflections see diffuse.
Simple diffuse material. Straightforward. Nothing special. Just a surface where light would reflect in a diffuse way.
Simple white sun light. Straightforward. Nothing special. Just a sun illuminating the whole scene evenly.

Need an environment with yellow, green, red and brown leaves of a tree. Need to test a render algorithm where many thousand translucent objects (the leaves) should still let some light through but also get darker and darker...
Simple translucent effect. Lets some light through the material, but the material is not transparent, you cannot see through it.
Translucent material: Lets some light through the material, but the material is not transparent, you cannot see through it. E.g. Leaves, Skin, ...
Realistic, slightly yellowish, sun light. Tries to simulate the real sun's daytime color.
